features.nativeEquivalent: Paint and Photos handle individual image edits; Clipchamp covers common video editing.

features.status: Implemented PNG/JPEG/BMP batches, resizing, JPEG quality/byte limits, text watermarks and offline English OCR; MP4/M4A and trimmed animated GIF batches. MP4 per-file size limits enforce actual output bytes with bounded re-encoding and audio-aware rates. Native tests preserve decoded video/audio and source bytes, handle silent input, strict-cap failure, unique names, mixed-file failures and preparation/encoder-progress cancellation. 157 core and 18 x64 backend checks pass; ARM64 cross-build passes without a runtime claim. Image/video form controls pass focused rendered checks, while picker-based conversion remains unverified. PNG/BMP and M4A size budgets and advanced editing remain deferred.

supplementalCapabilities.status: Implemented delay, session-lock and suspend clearing of the current clipboard; Windows history is not deleted.
Implemented sustained CPU/memory and low disk alerts. Separate NVIDIA thermal alerts are implemented subject to driver capability.
Implemented PNG save picker; no Explorer extension.
Per-monitor click-through dimming overlays implemented; monitorBrightness separately provides DDC/CI hardware brightness when the connection reports support.
Implemented explicit folder selection, bounded metadata scan, age review, selected-file recycling and changed-file/reparse-point checks. No automatic deletion or message database access.
Implemented schema-checked JSON import/export, ordering and preserved disabled-feature settings.
Implemented four native WinUI steps; selections persist between launches.
English only in this initial port; other language resources deferred.
Implemented NVIDIA temperature threshold, sustained duration, cooldown and no-hardware behavior. Real RTX 3080 readings remain unverified.
Implemented as savedLayouts: named custom positions, display-relative restore and one-step undo; no Snap engine or custom snapping gestures.
Implemented as windowSearch: title/app search, display filter and activation; no Alt+Tab replacement.

Implemented clipboard/file image pins, six-preview limit, native Mica windows, topmost toggle and close-all. Nine backend integration checks pass per architecture. Installed ARM64 file/clipboard rendering, topmost/unpin, resizing, Esc, close-all and feature-disable cleanup passed; the six-pin UI limit and exit cleanup remain unchecked.
